Here are the available commands and their input schema for 'monitor' tool.
If you do not find a suitable "command", run again with the "learn=true" to get a list of available commands and their parameters.
Next, identify the command you want to execute and run again with the "command" and "parameters" arguments, respecting "required" parameters if present.

query accepts KQL syntax.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"workspace":{"type":"string","description":"The Log Analytics workspace ID or name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."}},"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"monitor_traces_field_list","description":"List the field names exposed by a distributed-trace account. buckets: `traceFields` (attributes on the trace row, e.g. trace_id, duration_nano,
span_count) and `spanFields` (attributes on individual spans, e.g. name,
service.name, http.request.method, and the nested `attributes` struct). Use this to
discover the schema before composing KQL queries for `monitor traces query run`.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."},"subscription":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure subscription GUID identifier or display name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"workspace":{"type":"string","description":"The name of the Azure Monitor Workspace enabled for Trace Store."}},"required":["resource-group","workspace"],"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"monitor_traces_query_run","description":"Run a KQL query on a distributed-trace account to find, filter, and
analyze spans, traces, service latency, request errors, top-slowest operations, and
per-service telemetry from OpenTelemetry-instrumented applications. The trace
account is an Azure Monitor Workspace enabled for Trace Store. Typical prompts:
"show traces from service X over the last N minutes", "top slowest traces for
service X", "find traces with errors in the last hour", "trace by trace-id /
span-id". The command submits the
query and collects results pages within a 180-second and requested-row budget.
If a budget is exhausted, returns collected rows with `status: "Running"` and an operationId
— use `monitor traces query resume --operation-id <id>` to continue the existing query.
Queries run with the caller's Azure identity — the caller must have read
access on the Azure Monitor Workspace.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."},"subscription":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure subscription GUID identifier or display name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"workspace":{"type":"string","description":"The name of the Azure Monitor Workspace enabled for Trace Store."},"query":{"type":"string","description":"KQL query for the TraceStore three-part dialect. STRUCTURE: <trace-filter> $$ <<span-filter>> $$ <<aggregation>> — include ONLY the parts you need; do NOT add empty <<>> blocks, a bare 'Traces $$' prefix, or a bare `<<span-filter>>` with no leading trace fragment (start with `Traces` or use `Traces $$ <<...>>` as a pass-through). Every fragment (the trace part and each <<>> block) must start with 'Traces' and chain operators with '|'. PLACEMENT: trace-level fields (e.g. duration_nano, span_count) go OUTSIDE <<>>; span-level fields in `where` predicates go INSIDE <<>>. Reference dotted span fields with bracket syntax ['span.x.y'] — never bare span.x.y and never joined with 'and'. PROJECTING SPAN FIELDS: `<<>>` is for span-level `where` predicates ONLY — do NOT put `project ['span.x']` inside `<<>>` (silently returns TRACE rows, not span rows). To project span fields, put the `project` clause at the TOP LEVEL (outside `<<>>`) AND pass `--include-spans true`, e.g. `Traces | where trace_id == '...' | project trace_id, ['span.name'], ['span.duration_nano']`. Combine with a `<<span-filter>>` block via `$$` when you also need span-level predicates. SAME vs DIFFERENT span: inside one <<>> block, '$$' separates conditions that must each match a DIFFERENT span; to require several conditions on the SAME span, chain '| where' clauses in one fragment. SPAN HIERARCHY (inside <<>>): `X ~> Y` means X is a strict ancestor of Y at any depth; `<~` reverses it. They bind tighter than `$$` and chain left-to-right. Parentheses require a shared span: `X ~> (Y $$ Z)` means the same X is above both; `(X ~> Y) $$ (X ~> Z)` may match different X spans. Prefer one complete structural query over separate queries for each part of the relationship. AGGREGATION: a summarize MUST be a separate SECOND <<>> block preceded by a span-filter <<>> block joined with $$; a standalone <<Traces | summarize ...>> is treated as a span filter and returns rows, not aggregates. If you have no span filter, use a pass-through <<Traces>> as the first block. GOTCHAS: `take` is NOT supported — use `--max-results` to limit rows; comparison operators >= and <= are NOT supported (rewrite as > N-1 / < N+1); negations: `!=`, `!in`, `!contains`, `!has` work; `!startswith` and `!endswith` do NOT — rewrite with `!contains` or negate the positive filter client-side; ago()/now() in where are silently broken (use `--start-time`/`--end-time`); supported aggregations (definitive): count, sum, min, max, percentile — anything else needs a workaround; `summarize ... by bin()` using bin() function silently returns null; for histograms, fetch raw values with a top-level project of the span field (one query) and bucket client-side — do NOT emit one query per bucket; bare `summarize <aggregation>()` without a `by` clause fails; `order by` inside a `<<>>` aggregation block is silently dropped — omit it and sort client-side after the response; timespan literals like 1s are silently null — use explicit nanoseconds; matches regex returns arbitrary rows — use startswith/endswith/contains; per-query time-range is capped at 1 day. EXAMPLES: 'Traces' (all traces); 'Traces | where duration_nano > 10' (trace filter); 'Traces | where span_count in (2, 3)' (trace filter, multiple values); '<<Traces | where ['span.name'] == 'GET'>>' (span filter); '<<Traces | where ['span.name'] == 'GET' | where ['span.status.code'] == 'Error'>>' (SAME span, chained where); '<<Traces | where ['span.name'] in ('GET', 'BlobClient.Upload')>>' (span filter, multiple values); 'Traces | where duration_nano > 10 $$ <<Traces | where ['span.name'] != 'GET' $$ Traces | where ['span.name'] == 'BlobClient.Upload'>>' (trace + two DIFFERENT spans); '<<Traces | where ['span.service.namespace'] == 'my-ns'>> $$ <<Traces | summarize count=count() by ['span.service.namespace']>>' (aggregation with span filter); '<<Traces>> $$ <<Traces | summarize count=count() by ['span.service.name']>>' (aggregation, no filter); 'Traces | where duration_nano > 10 $$ <<Traces | where ['span.name'] == 'GET'>> $$ <<Traces | summarize sum=sum(duration_nano) by ['span.name']>>' (all three parts)."},"start-time":{"type":"string","description":"Query start time in UTC ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-07-24T20:00:00Z). Defaults to 30 minutes before end-time."},"end-time":{"type":"string","description":"Query end time in UTC ISO 8601. Defaults to the current UTC time."},"max-results":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Total rows requested for the new query and collected per call. Default 100; clamped to 1-1000. Whole backend pages may exceed the request."},"include-spans":{"type":["boolean","null"],"description":"Include span-level detail in the response. Default true."}},"required":["resource-group","workspace","query"],"additionalProperties":false}},{"command":"monitor_traces_query_resume","description":"Resume polling an existing distributed-trace query by operation id,
without submitting a new query. Requires the Azure Monitor Workspace and resource group.
Collects further results pages within a 180-second and 1000-row budget per call.
Whole pages are retained and may exceed the requested row budget.
Returns Succeeded on the final page, or Running with collected rows when a budget
is exhausted. Read results sequentially, not with parallel callers or replay retries.
Use `monitor traces query run` for a new query, or
`monitor traces query cancel` to stop one.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"operation-id":{"type":"string","description":"Operation id returned by 'monitor traces query run'."},"page-size":{"type":["integer","null"],"description":"Rows requested per results page. Default 100; clamped to 1-1000. Does not change the submitted query's total row limit."},"include-spans":{"type":["boolean","null"],"description":"Include span-level detail in the response. Default true."},"resource-group":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure resource group name."},"workspace":{"type":"string","description":"The name of the Azure Monitor Workspace enabled for Trace Store."},"subscription":{"type":"string","description":"The Azure subscription GUID identifier or display name. If not specified, the Azure CLI profile default subscription or AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID environment variable will be used."},"tenant":{"type":"string","description":"The Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID identifier or display name."}},"required":["operation-id","resource-group","workspace"],"additionalProperties":false}}]
